memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: Routine follow‑up of glaucoma, psoriasis and hypothyroidism.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports stable vision, mild scalp scaling, no fatigue or weight change.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/86 mmHg, weight 68 kg, height 1.55 m, BMI 28.3 (obese). Intraocular pressure 22 mmHg OU, anterior chamber clear. Skin shows mild erythematous plaques on elbows and knees, no pustules. Thyroid examination normal.
IMPRESSION: Glaucoma IOP at upper limit of normal, psoriasis mild, hypothyroidism euthyroid on levothyroxine 50 mcg.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue timolol BD, latanoprost HS, clobetasol BD, calcipotriol OD, methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly + folic acid 5 mg OD, levothyroxine 50 mcg OD. Advise low‑salt diet, 150 min/week brisk walking. Return if eye pain, sudden vision loss, joint swelling, fever >39 °C, or bleeding.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Timolol 0.5% eye drops – 1 drop each eye BD
Latanoprost 0.005% eye drops – 1 drop each eye HS
Clobetasol 0.05% cream – apply BD to affected areas
Calcipotriol ointment – apply OD to plaques
Methotrexate 7.5 mg – take once weekly with food
Folic acid 5 mg – take OD
Levothyroxine 50 mcg – take OD morning

CBC: Hb 12.8 g/dl (12‑16), WBC 6.5×10⁹/L (4‑10), platelets 250×10⁹/L (150‑400).
Creatinine: 0.9 mg/dl (0.6‑1.2).
TSH: 4.2 mIU/L (0.4‑4.0). Free T4: 1.1 ng/dL (0.8‑1.8).

Reason for visit: 6‑month check of glaucoma, psoriasis, hypothyroidism.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Reports occasional eye irritation after drops, stable skin, no fatigue.
EXAMINATION: BP 134/82 mmHg, weight 66 kg, BMI 27.5 (obese). IOP 21 mmHg OD, 20 mmHg OS. Anterior chambers quiet. Skin: minimal erythema on knees, no plaques. Thyroid: normal size.
IMPRESSION: Glaucoma IOP at target, psoriasis well controlled, euthyroid on levothyroxine 75 mcg.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue timolol BD, latanoprost HS, clobetasol BD, calcipotriol OD, methotrexate 10 mg weekly + folic acid, levothyroxine 75 mcg. Order annual lipid profile and fasting glucose. Advise maintain activity, limit saturated fat. Return if eye pain, vision loss, new joint swelling, fever >39 °C, or unexplained bruising.

Reason for visit: 3‑month follow‑up after lipid check, glaucoma, psoriasis, hypothyroidism.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Mild foreign‑body sensation in both eyes, skin lesions unchanged, feels well.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/80 mmHg, weight 66 kg, BMI 27.2 (obese). IOP 22 mmHg OD, 21 mmHg OS. Corneal epithelium intact. Skin: faint pink patches on elbows, no scaling. Thyroid: non‑enlarged.
IMPRESSION: IOP slightly elevated, consider adding brimonidine; psoriasis mild; euthyroid.
ARRANGEMENTS: Add brimonidine 0.2% eye drops BD OU, continue timolol BD, latanoprost HS, topical steroids, methotrexate 10 mg weekly + folic acid, levothyroxine 75 mcg. Repeat IOP in 1 month, LFT in 3 months. Return if eye pain, vision loss, joint swelling, fever >39 °C, or bruising.

Reason for visit: Routine review of glaucoma, psoriasis, hypothyroidism after IOP adjustment.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Eye irritation improved with brimonidine, skin lesions stable, no systemic symptoms.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/78 mmHg, weight 65 kg, BMI 27.0 (obese). IOP 20 mmHg OD, 19 mmHg OS. Anterior chambers quiet. Skin: minimal erythema on knees, no plaques. Thyroid: normal.
IMPRESSION: Glaucoma IOP controlled on triple therapy, psoriasis mild, euthyroid.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue timolol BD, latanoprost HS, brimonidine BD, clobetasol BD, calcipotriol OD, methotrexate 10 mg weekly + folic acid, levothyroxine 75 mcg. Order LFT and CBC in 3 months, TSH in 6 months. Advise continue low‑salt diet, 150 min/week walk. Return if eye pain, vision loss, joint swelling, fever >39 °C, or unusual bleeding.
